Q: `do.call` blows up final object size (returned object is not identical to direct function call) A:

The problem is that in out2 the arguments are evaluated before passing them. If we use "lm" and quote the arguments to prevent that then the results are the same. In the case of lm it uses match.call so this matters.

out1 = lm(mpg~wt, data = mtcars)
out2 = do.call(lm, list(quote(mpg~wt), data = quote(mtcars)), quote = TRUE)
identical(out1, out2)
## [1] TRUE

Q: Build an app for iPhone no apple developer account A:

I found out that (if I'm not wrong) for an app made with Flutter it is not possible, unless I do every week some procedure.

Right -- if you're building a native app (including apps built with Flutter) using a free Apple developer account, you'll need to either rebuild it every 7 days. The free account is meant for development, not for distributing a finished app (even if you're only distributing to yourself). There's more info in this answer. There are some other limits as well: you can only register 3 test devices instead of the 100 devices afforded by the paid membership, you can only install 3 apps per device, and you can only create 10 app IDs. See the Enable a Personal Team in Xcode section on the Developer account overview page.

Is there some other tool like I don't know React Native or something else with which there is a way to do it?

You can build a web app, of course, but I don't think that's what you're looking for. Apps that are compiled for and installed on iOS/iPadOS devices need a valid provision profile in order to run, and the profile that you can create with a free account has the 7-day limit baked in.

Q: Google Workspace Add-ons: Building HTML interface possible? A:

You have to use CardService for Workspace Add-ons.

Only Editor add-ons (and Web Apps) allow for building custom interfaces with HTML/CSS and client-side javascript. Moreover, if User-Privacy and Anti-Trust laws/legislation keep gaining traction(GDPR, CCPA, etc.), there's a good chance we'll lose even that, but I digress.

If you're looking for official documentation on the matter, see Restrictions

Q: Add seconds to an existing date in Lua A: 
print("Server Script Timer Global started")
local increment = 0

function startTimer()
    local referenz = os.time()
    while true do        
        if (referenz < os.time()) then
            print(increment)
            increment = increment + 1
            return startTimer()
        end
    end
end
    
startTimer()

Q: Bad MIME type for CSS @import A:

The path is used in the import directive is incorrect. If you use the following directory structure then you should use a relative path to the resource.

../src/components/shared-styles/shared.css

or

import './components/shared-styles/shared.css'
